en: Arrangement between the Kingdom of Sweden, represented by Försvarets materielverk, and the Kingdom of Norway, represented by the Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency, and the Finnish Defence Forces, represented by the Finnish Defence Forces Logistics Command, and the Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport of Switzerland, and the Minister of Defence of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and the Ministry of Defence of Denmark, represented by the Danish Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation, and the Republic of Estonia, represented by the Estonian Defence Forces through Support Command, and the Czech Republic, represented by the Force Development Department of the Ministry of Defence of the Czech Republic, and the Slovak Republic, represented by the Department of Capability Programs of the Armed Forces of the Slovak Republic, concerning the CV90 Club.
